description: Opening journal entry passed on 01-Apr-2026 to bring forward asset, liability, and capital balances from previous financial year's audited Balance Sheet for sole proprietorship retail firm

creditLines.account: HDFC Bank Term Loan Liability Account

narration: Being opening balances of assets, liabilities, and proprietor capital brought forward on 01-Apr-2026
explanation: Standard Opening Entry: All asset accounts are debited (Total Dr ₹10,00,000) and all liability & equity accounts are credited (Total Cr ₹10,00,000) to open the new financial year books.

description: Opening entry passed on taking over an existing running business firm where total liabilities and capital exceed tangible assets, establishing Goodwill as balancing figure
narration: Being assets and liabilities taken over with excess consideration credited to Goodwill A/c
explanation: Goodwill Opening Entry: When total liabilities plus capital (₹3,50,000) exceed tangible assets (₹3,00,000), the debit balancing figure of ₹50,000 is recognized as Goodwill Asset.

description: Opening entry passed on acquiring a running manufacturing unit where net tangible assets acquired exceed purchase consideration, establishing Capital Reserve

creditLines.account: Capital Reserve Account (Capital Gain Balancing Figure)

narration: Being net manufacturing assets acquired with excess net asset value credited to Capital Reserve
explanation: Capital Reserve Opening Entry: When tangible assets acquired (₹12,50,000) exceed liabilities plus capital (₹11,50,000), the credit balancing figure of ₹1,00,000 is transferred to Capital Reserve.

description: Opening entry passed for continuing partnership firm 'Gupta & Sons' bringing forward assets, trade liabilities, and individual partner capital balances
narration: Being opening assets and liabilities brought forward into partnership ledger accounts
explanation: Partnership Opening Entry: Credits individual capital accounts for Partner Amit Gupta (₹7,80,000) and Partner Sumit Gupta (₹5,20,000) alongside liabilities.

description: Opening entry passed for service enterprise CNAT Tech Consultancy bringing forward accrued income receivables and prepaid software license assets

debitLines.account: Prepaid Annual Software License & Rent Account

creditLines.account: Advance Client Fees Received Liability Account

narration: Being service entity opening assets, prepaid deferred expenses, and liabilities brought forward
explanation: Service Entity Opening Entry: Carries forward accrued fee receivables (Asset Dr ₹45k), prepaid software licenses (Asset Dr ₹35k), and advance client retainers (Liability Cr ₹30k).

description: Opening entry passed for trading firm bringing forward provision for doubtful debts reserve alongside trade debtors
narration: Being opening balances including provision for doubtful debts reserve brought forward
explanation: Brings forward Provision for Doubtful Debts contra-asset reserve of ₹5,000 on credit side alongside assets and liabilities.

description: Opening entry passed for manufacturing plant bringing forward accumulated depreciation reserves
narration: Being opening plant assets brought forward at cost with accumulated depreciation reserves
explanation: Brings forward gross asset cost on debit side and accumulated depreciation reserve on credit side.

description: Opening entry passed for retail shop with bank overdraft liability and cash balance
narration: Being opening balances including bank overdraft liability brought forward
explanation: Bank Overdraft is credited as current liability (Credit Bank OD A/c ₹50,000) in opening entry.

description: Opening entry passed for branch office receiving asset and liability balances from head office
narration: Being opening branch net assets credited to Head Office Account
explanation: Branch opening entry debits branch assets and credits Head Office Account with net balance ₹2,30,000.

description: Opening entry passed for professional practice carrying forward unbilled work-in-progress asset
narration: Being professional practice opening balances including unbilled WIP asset brought forward
explanation: Carries forward Unbilled Work-in-Progress as current asset (Debit Unbilled WIP A/c ₹55,000).
